# Investor Update Email - Draft

Monthly update to existing investors (Granite Peak and angels). Aleks sends it; I write the product/eng part and he edits. Not to Northfield, they get the data room. Careful: nothing here that isn't also in the data room. Same facts, same words.

---

**Subject:** Stencil, September update

Hi all,

Quick September update. The headline you already know: we signed a term sheet with Northfield Ventures on Sep 22, $38M at $210M post, with Granite Peak taking pro-rata. Thank you, Dana, for the help on that. We're in diligence now and targeting a close around Nov 14.

**Numbers (end of September)**
- 151k MAU (from 120k in May)
- 101k MTU (from 78k)
- $5.3M subscription ARR (from $4.1M)
- Burn $540k/mo, 15 months runway pre-close

**Product and engineering**
- Investing beta has been live since Sep 8 with about 5k users. We held GA at our first go/no-go on Sep 29 to fix a position reconciliation issue and finish Android parity. Second go/no-go is Oct 16, GA target Oct 20.
- On Sep 26 a background job double-debited 1,412 customers about $9 each. We caught it in 47 minutes and reversed every debit the same day. Our sponsor bank was informed within 24 hours. The root cause was a missing safeguard on an older system that we're now moving onto the new payment pipeline we built after April. Full write-up available on request.
- The new ACH pipeline has run since Aug 18 with zero missed cutoffs.
- Card issuing moves to Q1 2027 so the team can focus on investing GA and the round.

**Team**
- We're in final stages of our VP Engineering search with two strong finalists.
- 64 people, 31 in engineering.

**Asks**
- Senior payments engineers and senior iOS engineers. If you know someone, an intro to Maya helps a lot.

Thanks,
Aleks and Maya

---

## Notes
- [ ] Aleks: edit pass by 2026-10-10
- [ ] Send by 2026-10-13, after the data room is up
- Open question: mention Sep 26 at all in an investor email? Aleks unsure. I want it in. They'll hear it from Northfield's diligence otherwise, and the board meeting is Oct 21.
- Decision: no VP Eng names in the email. Decision isn't made.
